_comment: The only file you edit to change what the monitor watches. Add a group by pasting its URL into the right region. No script or plist changes needed, and no reload — each scheduled run reads this file fresh. A group must be one the signed-in account has already joined; the collector sees exactly what you would see, so an unjoined group returns nothing rather than erroring. Run 'npm run fb:check' after editing to confirm every group is reachable.
